sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)

[1] This is a wholly misconceived petition seeking for a direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the Respondent No. 3 namely the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority to consider the representation made by the petitioner claiming certain benefits in the matter of assessment of compensation under the Award dated 18.01.2021.

It is stated by the petitioner in the writ petition that aggrieved by the award, an application was moved by the petitioner for making reference under Section 64 of the Right to NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/3727/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/07/2024 Jayeshbhai Karsanbhai Rana vs State Of Gujarat on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146785494/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, whereafter the matter has been referred to the Competent Authority under Section 64, which is pending as on date.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: [2] Further, applications / representations have been filed by the petitioner before the Competent Authority and the prayer made in the writ petition is to issue direction to the Competent Authority to consider the same.

[3] We find that when the matter is engaging attention of the Competent Authority under Section 64, there is no occasion to issue any direction to consider one or more materials put forth by the petitioner.
No mandamus, as prayed for, thus can be granted.
The petition is dismissed as misconceived.

(SUNITA AGARWAL, CJ ) (PRANAV TRIVEDI,J) SAHIL S. RANGER Jayeshbhai Karsanbhai Rana vs State Of Gujarat on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146785494/
